title: ServiceTimingEvent
description: Emitted by a ticket-timer sensor at each stage transition of an order's lifecycle. Simulated today; future adapter target e.g. a KDS vendor API. Revised 2026-08-26: split former 'expo_hold'/'delivered' ambiguity into distinct 'plated' -> 'picked_up_by_server' -> 'delivered' stages.

source_kind.description: simulated: generated by an edge simulator. vendor_integration: a real vendor system. player: a human-driven source (the version-2 game client via game-bridge). Revised 2026-09-20: added 'player'.

stage.description: order_fired: ticket sent to kitchen. cook_started: line cook begins prep. plated: food ready at expo/pass. picked_up_by_server: server physically takes the plate from the pass — distinct from plated so kitchen-side cook time and front-of-house pickup delay are separately measurable. delivered: food reaches the table.

elapsed_since_previous_stage_ms.description: Duration since the prior stage event for this ticket, computed by the producer. Null on the first stage.
